ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated reporting and AI pricing can absorb entry-level calculations, but actuaries still own model assumptions, regulatory judgment, and signing responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 33,600 actuaries employed in 2024, rising to a projected 40,900 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 7,300 jobs and about 2,400 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $125,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace actuaries, but it will take over much of the repetitive calculation and report generation. Models run and parameters adjust automatically, shifting actuaries from operating calculators to setting models, reviewing results, and explaining them to regulators. Pure execution roles face the most pressure, while people who combine modeling with compliance become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Model design: people set the assumptions.
Regulatory judgment: people ensure compliance.
Signing responsibility: people provide final approval.
Business interpretation: people handle communication.
Extreme scenarios: people exercise judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this occupation in the relatively high AI exposure segment of finance. Reporting and pricing can be automated, but risk judgment and final compliance review still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is calculation and execution, not actuarial decision-making. Fully credentialed actuaries who can model and work with regulators become scarcer as technology advances. People who only produce templated reports face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in mathematics and statistics, plan your SOA/CAS exam path early, and do not focus only on the degree.
Move beyond producing reports to setting models and working with regulators. Build credentials and experience across real insurance scenarios.
Highlight your modeling work and exam progress, and specify which product lines you have supported.
Evaluate candidates on exam progress and modeling fundamentals. Invest in core staff who can take responsibility for decisions.

ai_s7_trends: AI-powered dynamic pricing becomes widespread.
RegTech lowers compliance costs.
Professionals who combine credentials with modeling skills become more sought after.

body: Actuaries use mathematical, statistical, and financial models to assess insurance, pension, and financial risks and calculate rates, reserves, and solvency.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动化报表和 AI 定价能吞掉初级核算，但模型设定、监管判断与签字责任，还是精算师扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精算师职业诊断在岗约 3.36 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.09 万人，净增约 0.73 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.58 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精算师，但会吃掉大量重复核算与报表生成。模型自动跑、参数自动调，精算师从「按计算器」转向「设模型、把关、对监管解释」。真正被挤掉的是纯执行层，会建模又会合规的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 模型设定：假设靠人。
监管判断：合规靠人。
签字责任：终审靠人。
业务解释：沟通靠人。
极端情景：判断靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的金融区——报表和定价能自动化，但风险判断与合规终审还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「核算执行」，不是「精算决策」的岗位。持证全、能建模又能跟监管的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会按模板出表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学统计打底，早点规划 SOA/CAS 考证路线，别只盯文凭。
从出表升级成设模型 + 跟监管，攒持证和场景经验。
突出建模与考证进度，写清跟过哪些产品线。
选人看持证进度和模型功底，能担责的骨干值得给资源。

ai_s7_trends: AI 动态定价普及。
监管科技压合规成本。
持证 + 建模复合人才更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI cameras can scan an entire runway, but someone on site must immediately handle an oil spill that appears before dawn or a stray cat that runs onto the pavement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 16,900 Airfield Operations Specialists employed in 2024, rising to a projected 17,600 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 700 jobs and about 1,600 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $56,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Airfield Operations Specialists, but it will take over inspection records and monitoring. AI runway foreign object debris detection, camera inspections, and wildlife data analysis increasingly replace constant visual pavement monitoring. People remain essential for on-site response, multi-party coordination, and emergencies.
ai_s2_accel: Round-the-clock pavement monitoring by intelligent cameras
AI bird-strike risk prediction and wildlife-control dispatch
Intelligent dispatch for deicing and snow removal
Coordination through digital operations management platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection and analysis of bird activity data
System-based sharing of flight and operational information
ai_s3_list: On-site inspection and judgment: AI alerts provide leads, but people must verify actual pavement conditions.
Emergency response: react correctly within seconds to runway incursions and aircraft emergency notifications.
Multi-party coordination: every message among the tower, airlines, airfield crews, and contractors carries responsibility.
Extreme-weather operations: organizing deicing, snow removal, and high-wind response depends on experience and teamwork.
Safety sensitivity: checking again when everything looks normal must become professional instinct.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means records, monitoring, and data analysis form a meaningful share of the role and are being rapidly absorbed by smart-airport systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. AI expands monitoring and shifts people toward confirmation and response, the irreplaceable link in the safety chain. Roles based only on manual runway patrols and handwritten records will shrink, while operations specialists who respond and coordinate remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Airport operations management and civil aviation programs provide the standard path, with routes for military veterans as well. Master safety regulations and emergency procedures, and maintain English skills because international airports often require them. People who understand systems and handle incidents on site gain value in the AI era.

Use intelligent inspection and AI monitoring systems rather than resisting new technology. Build experience in operations command, wildlife hazard management, and obstacle limitation management, and earn relevant qualifications. These specialties are more resistant to replacement.

People with civil aviation, safety management, or driving backgrounds have transition advantages. Start with airfield inspections and describe specific experience on your resume, such as handling XX emergencies or participating in XX deicing or inspection assignments.

Hire operations specialists for responsibility before technical ability. A safety role needs more than someone who can drive. Invest in people who understand systems, handle incidents, and coordinate effectively.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic identification and location of foreign objects
Real-time monitoring of pavement, lighting, and perimeter fencing
Dispatch of operating vehicles and processes
Sharing flight, operation, and incident information
Wind, snow, and visibility data integration

ai_s7_trends: As smart airports expand, AI inspections and system monitoring are becoming common. Operations specialists shift from inspection records to confirmation and response.
Airport expansion and general aviation growth create roles, increasing demand for operations command and safety management.
Stricter safety oversight and stronger qualification and training systems create a clear premium for operations professionals with combined skills.

body: Airfield Operations Specialists inspect and coordinate maintenance of runways, taxiways, lighting, and obstacle-free environments. They organize construction and deicing, manage wildlife hazards, and respond to emergencies to protect aircraft ground operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 摄像头能扫遍整条跑道，但凌晨那摊突然出现的油渍、那只冲上跑道的流浪猫，需要有人在现场马上处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机场运行专员在岗约 1.69 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.76 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.16 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机场运行专员，但会接管巡视记录与监测。AI 跑道异物检测、摄像头巡检、鸟情数据分析，正在替代「人眼盯道面」。剩下的现场处置、多方协调、应急处置，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 智能摄像头全天候道面监测
AI 鸟击风险预测与驱鸟调度
除冰雪作业的智能调度
数字化运行管理平台协同
ai_s2_auto: AI 跑道 FOD 自动检测
巡视记录与台账电子化
鸟情监测数据的自动采集分析
航班与作业信息的系统化共享
ai_s3_list: 现场巡查与判断：AI 报警是提示，道面到底是什么情况，得人到场确认。
突发事件处置：跑道侵入、特情通报，几秒内要反应正确。
多方协调：塔台、航空、场务、施工，传话带话之间全是责任。
极端天气作业：除冰雪、防大风，现场组织靠经验和默契。
安全敏感度：把「看起来没事」再查一遍的习惯，是职业本能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的记录、监测、数据分析比重不小，这些正被智慧机场系统快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让监测更全面，反而把人力推向「确认与处置」——这才是安全链条上 AI 替代不了的一环。真正被挤压的是「纯人工巡道、手动抄记录」的岗位，会处置、能协调的运行专员依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机场运行管理、民航类专业是正路，退伍军人也有通道。把安全规章和应急流程吃透，英语别丢——国际机场对外语有要求。AI 时代，会看系统、能现场处置的人更吃香。
把智慧巡检与 AI 监测系统用起来，别抵触新技术。往运行指挥、鸟防、净空管理等方向积累，考取相关资质，这些岗位更抗替代。
有民航、安全管理、驾驶背景者转型有优势。从飞行区巡查做起，简历里多写「处理过XX次突发、参与过XX除冰/巡检任务」这类具体经历。
招运行专员先看责任心再看技术——安全岗不能只要「会开车的人」。懂系统、能处置、协调能力强的人，值得重点培养。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: BIM can generate drawings automatically, but drafters still decide which details need development, how to coordinate disciplines, and how to communicate complex construction assemblies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 110,500 Architectural And Civil Drafters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 115,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 4,600 jobs, with roughly 10,000 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $64,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace architectural drafters, but it will reduce basic roles. BIM and parametric tools accelerate standard drawings. Drafters can shift from tracing toward model coordination, detail development, code control, and multidisciplinary communication. Standard-only drafting faces the most pressure, while professionals who coordinate and develop complex details become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Complex detail development: people solve difficult conditions.
Multidisciplinary coordination: people resolve conflicts.
Code implementation: people define the interpretation.
Construction judgment: people choose the assembly.
Drawing communication: people organize the logic.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this career in the moderate AI exposure range for drafting work. Systems accelerate standard drawings, while coordination and detail development remain human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. AI replaces standard drawing production, not model coordination. Drafters with coordination and detail-development skills become more scarce as tools improve efficiency. Standard-only drafters face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with civil engineering or architecture and practice BIM and coordination. Pure tracing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop detail skills early.
Move beyond tracing toward model coordination. Learn building-services coordination and code requirements, then pursue discipline-lead responsibility.
Highlight software and project experience. State clearly which disciplines you have worked with. Design institutes value precision and dependable delivery.
Do not assess candidates by drawing speed alone. Evaluate coordination judgment. Professionals who can lead a discipline merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: BIM adoption is reducing basic roles.
Complex coordination creates opportunities.
Strong detail-development skills are in greater demand.

body: Architectural And Civil Drafters use CAD and BIM to develop design concepts into construction drawings, annotate assemblies and materials, and coordinate implementation details with structural, mechanical, electrical, and other disciplines.
career_ai_description_block.heading: BIM can generate drawings automatically, but drafters still decide which details need development, how to coordinate disciplines, and how to communicate complex construction assemblies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: BIM 能自动出图，但哪类节点值得细画、怎么协调跨专业、复杂构造怎么表达，还是制图员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年建筑土木制图员在岗约 11.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.51 万人，净增约 0.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代建筑制图员，但会压缩基础岗。BIM 与参数化把标准图纸提速，制图员从「纯描图」挪向「模型协调、节点深化、规范把控、跨专业对接」。真正被挤掉的是只画标准图的人，有协调力能深化的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 复杂节点深化：难点靠人解。
跨专业协调：矛盾靠人调。
规范落地：口径靠人定。
构造判断：做法靠人选。
图纸表达：逻辑靠人理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的制图区——标准图被系统加速，但协调与深化还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「画标准图」动作，不是「模型协调」的岗位。有协调力、能深化的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会描标准图的制图员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 土木/建筑起步多练 BIM 和协调，AI 时代纯描图在缩，早点练深化。
从「纯描图」升级成「模型 + 协调」，学管综与规范，争取专业负责。
突出软件与项目经验，写清跟过哪些专业。设计院看重稳和细。
选人别只看出图速度，要看有没有协调脑子。能做专业负责的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: BIM 普及，基础岗缩。
复杂协调有机会。
有深化力更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage parts and work orders, but repairers still decide which spoke to tighten and how the adjustment should feel.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 13,200 bicycle repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 12,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 300 jobs, with approximately 1,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $40,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bicycle repairers, but it will accelerate shop logistics. Digitization improves parts lookup, scheduling, and diagnostic libraries, shifting repair work from finding parts toward precise diagnosis, complex bicycle tuning, and premium customization. People limited to simple maintenance face the most pressure, while repairers with tactile skill who can service premium bicycles become more secure.
ai_s3_list: Tactile judgment: people perform tuning.
Complex diagnosis: people identify root causes.
Premium customization: people design solutions.
Test-ride acceptance: people judge the experience.
Communication advice: people understand needs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means bicycle repair remains highly dependent on tactile skill and experience, while only logistics and administrative processes are accelerating.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean no impact. Digitization accelerates parts lookup and scheduling, not diagnostic and tuning roles. People with tactile skill who can repair complex bicycles become more secure, while repairers limited to simple maintenance face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: As an apprentice, develop tactile skill and experience with premium bicycles. Simple work is shrinking in the AI era, so practice diagnosis early.
Advance from replacing parts to diagnosis and customization, and learn premium bicycles and electric-assist systems.
Emphasize the bicycle types you have repaired and describe complex cases clearly.
When hiring, look beyond speed to tactile skill and diagnostic judgment.

ai_s7_trends: Rising cycling participation drives demand
Growth in electric bicycle repair
Workers with strong hands-on judgment are in greater demand

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代自行车修理工，但会加速门店后勤。数字化把零配件、排单、诊断库提速，维修从「找件」挪向「精准诊断、复杂车调校、高端改装」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单保养的，有手感能修高端车的人更稳。

复杂诊断：病根靠人。
高端改装：方案靠人。
试骑验收：体验靠人。
沟通建议：需求靠人懂。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——维修高度依赖手感与经验，只有后勤环节在提速。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于没影响：被加速的是「找件排单」动作，不是「诊断调校」的岗位。有手感、能修复杂车的人，反而随数字化更稳。怕的是只做简单保养的工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学徒多练手感与高端车，AI 时代简单活在缩，早点练诊断。
从「换件」升级成「诊断 + 改装」，学高端车与电助。
突出修过哪些车型，写清复杂案例。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Standard workflows can be automated, but technicians still break down problems and interpret results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 5,000 bioinformatics technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 5,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with approximately 300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $71,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bioinformatics technicians, but it will automate standard analysis workflows. Pipelines run automatically and results receive initial screening, shifting technicians from executing workflows toward breaking down problems and interpreting anomalies. Pure execution faces displacement, while people who write scripts and interpret results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Problem decomposition: people apply reasoning.
Anomaly interpretation: people apply experience.
Workflow design: people exercise judgment.
Result review: people bear responsibility.
Biological significance: people communicate meaning.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10, relatively high, means this occupation has relatively high AI exposure in data workflows. Systems absorb pipeline execution, while problem decomposition and interpretation still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean complete risk. Pure pipeline execution faces replacement, not roles built around problem decomposition. People who write scripts and understand biology become scarcer as technology advances, while technicians limited to clicking Run face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build foundations in life science plus programming and practice scripting early.
Advance from execution to workflow design and build interpretation experience.
Emphasize scripting and quality control and identify the omics projects you supported.
When hiring, look for dual-domain knowledge and attention to detail. People who interpret results merit retention.

ai_s7_trends: Workflow automation.
Omics data grows rapidly.
Interpretation becomes scarcer.

body: Bioinformatics technicians build and run analysis workflows around sequencing and omics data, clean and align data, perform quality control, investigate anomalies, and turn raw reads into interpretable answers that support research and diagnosis.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Standard workflows can be automated, but technicians still break down problems and interpret results.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 标准流程能被自动化，但问题拆解与结果解读，还是技师扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物信息技术员在岗约 0.50 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.52 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生信技师，但会自动化标准分析流程。管线自跑、结果自初筛，技师从「跑流程」转向「拆问题、解读异常」。真正被挤掉的是纯执行，会脚本会解读的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 问题拆解：脑子靠人。
异常解读：经验靠人。
流程设计：判断靠人。
结果把关：责任靠人。
生物意义：沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的数据区——流程被吃，但拆解与解读仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「纯跑流程」，不是「问题拆解」的岗位。会脚本、懂生物的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会点运行的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 生科+编程打底，早点练脚本。
从执行升级成设计流程，攒解读。
突出脚本与质控，写清跟过哪些组学。
选人看双背景与细心，能解读的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 流程自动化。
组学数据爆炸。
解读更缺。

body: 生物信息技术员是围绕测序与组学数据，搭建与运行分析流程、清洗比对数据、质控排查异常，把原始读长变成能读的答案、支撑科研与诊断的职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 标准流程能被自动化，但问题拆解与结果解读，还是技师扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can analyze spectra and propose hypotheses, but people still choose the research topic, interpret anomalies, and determine how findings become practical applications.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,800 Chemists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 91,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,200 jobs, with about 6,300 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $84,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemists, but it will reduce repetitive experimental work. Automated synthesis and AI spectrum analysis accelerate routine operations, shifting Chemists from running instruments toward designing research, interpreting anomalies, translating findings across fields, and writing conclusions. People who design and translate research become more valuable; instrument-only roles face pressure.
ai_s3_list: Research design: people form the hypotheses.
Anomaly interpretation: people explain the mechanisms.
Cross-domain translation: people find the applications.
Experimental tradeoffs: people exercise judgment.
Safety control: people determine appropriate limits.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate repetitive experiments, but people retain a central role in design and translation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk: instrument operation is being replaced, not work that explains mechanisms. People who design research and translate findings become scarcer as productivity rises. Those limited to following experimental procedures face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Starting with a bachelor's degree in chemistry, practice experimental design and data analysis extensively. Routine experiments are shrinking in the AI era, so consider graduate study early.
Move from running experiments to design + translation. Learn data analysis and how to connect findings with applications.
Highlight research topics and translation experience, and specify the fields you have worked in.
Do not hire on education alone; assess whether candidates can design research and turn findings into practical outcomes.

ai_s7_trends: Automated synthesis is spreading, reducing repetitive experiments.
New materials and pharmaceuticals drive demand.
People who design research and translate findings are in greater demand.

body: Chemists apply chemical principles to study the composition, structure, and transformation of matter. They design experiments, analyze data, and apply findings to improve new materials, pharmaceuticals, and processes, making them core researchers in chemical science.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can analyze spectra and propose hypotheses, but people still choose the research topic, interpret anomalies, and determine how findings become practical applications.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能跑谱图提假设，但课题怎么定、异常怎么判、怎么落地应用，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年化学家职业诊断在岗约 8.68 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.10 万人，净增约 0.42 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.41 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代化学家，但会压缩「重复实验」的环节。自动化合成与谱图 AI 分析把常规操作提速，化学家从「跑仪器」转向「设计课题、研判异常、跨域转化、写结论」。会设计会转化的人更值钱，只跑仪器的人被挤。
ai_s3_list: 课题设计：假设靠人提。
异常研判：机理靠人。
跨域转化：应用靠人。
实验取舍：判断靠人。
安全把控：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——重复实验被系统加速，但设计与转化还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑仪器」动作，不是「搞清机理」的岗位。会设计会转化的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会按流程跑实验的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化学本科起步多练设计与数据，AI 时代纯跑实验在缩，早点读研。
从跑实验升级成「设计 + 转化」，学数据分析和应用对接。
突出课题与转化经验，写清做过哪些方向。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会 design 和落地。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化合成普及，重复实验缩。
新材料与药物带动需求。
会设计会转化的人更抢手。

body: 化学家运用化学原理研究物质的组成、结构与变化，设计实验并分析数据，将结论用于新材料、药物与工艺的创新与改进，是化学科学的核心研究者。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能跑谱图提假设，但课题怎么定、异常怎么判、怎么落地应用，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Quantity-takeoff software can produce a bill of quantities, but Cost Estimators still judge which items will rise and how to make a competitive bid.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 221,400 Cost Estimators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 212,100 by 2034, a net loss of about 9,300 jobs, with about 16,900 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $77,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cost Estimators, but it will accelerate quantity takeoffs and pricing. BIM takeoffs, price databases, and automated quotes speed up repetitive work. Estimators shift from processing line items to risk judgment, negotiation strategy, commercial decisions, and historical benchmarking. Pure takeoff and pricing work faces pressure, while people with commercial judgment and accountability become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Risk judgment: people identify omissions.
Negotiation strategy: people decide how to price the bid.
Commercial decisions: people decide whether to offer concessions.
Historical benchmarking: people interpret the market.
Site verification: people confirm whether quantities are correct.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate AI exposure in quantity estimation. Systems accelerate takeoffs and pricing, while judgment and negotiation remain human work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces takeoff and pricing actions, not commercial judgment. Estimators who negotiate and accept responsibility for quotes become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to processing lists face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in engineering or cost management and learn BIM and price databases during school. Pure quantity takeoff is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment and negotiation skills early.
Advance from processing lists to making judgments and negotiating commercial terms. Learn AI-assisted quoting and work toward a supervisor role.
Highlight bid and reconciliation experience and identify the projects you supported. Employers value consistency and accuracy.
Do not select candidates based only on credentials; assess their judgment. Lead estimators who take responsibility for bids merit strong bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Infrastructure and manufacturing demand remains stable.
Software performs takeoffs; people make judgments.
People with negotiation skills are more sought after.

body: Cost Estimators use drawings, bills of quantities, and market prices to calculate labor, material, equipment, and indirect costs for construction or manufacturing projects. They prepare bid and budget estimates, analyze risk, and inform commercial decisions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Quantity-takeoff software can produce a bill of quantities, but Cost Estimators still judge which items will rise and how to make a competitive bid.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 算量软件能帮你跑清单，但哪项会涨、怎么报才有竞争力，还是估算师一算一定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年成本估算师在岗约 22.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 21.21 万人，岗位净减约 0.93 万个，年均产生约 1.69 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代成本估算师，但会加速算量与套价。BIM 算量、价格库和自动报价把重复工作提速，估算师从「跑清单」挪向「风险判断、议价策略、商务决策、历史对标」。真正被挤掉的是纯算量套价，有商务脑子能扛责的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 风险判断：漏项靠人查。
议价策略：咋报靠人定。
商务决策：让不让利靠人。
历史对标：行情靠人读。
现场核实：量对不对靠人看。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的算量区——算量套价被系统加速，但判断与议价还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算量与套价」动作，不是「商务判断」的岗位。有议价力、能扛报价责任的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只跑清单的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工程或造价本科打底，在校多学 BIM 和价格库。AI 时代纯算量在缩，早点练判断和议价。
从「跑清单」升级成「做判断 + 谈商务」，学 AI 报价，争取做主管。
突出报价与对账经验，写清跟过哪些项目。公司看重稳和准。
选人别只看证，要看会不会判断。能扛报价的主估，值得给高奖金。

ai_s7_trends: 基建制造需求稳。
软件替算量，人做判断。
有议价力的人更抢手。

body: 成本估算师（Cost Estimators）依据图纸、清单与市场价，测算工程或制造项目的人工、材料、机械与间接费用，编制投标与预算报价，分析风险并支撑商务决策。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 算量软件能帮你跑清单，但哪项会涨、怎么报才有竞争力，还是估算师一算一定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI is getting faster at drafting environmental impact assessments and calculating process parameters, but environmental engineers still decide how a company should remediate a problem and whether an environmental investment is worthwhile.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, about 39,400 environmental engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 41,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with about 3,000 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $104,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace environmental engineers, but it will reshape how they work. It is greatly accelerating information-intensive tasks such as drafting environmental impact assessments, searching standards and regulations, and analyzing monitoring data, so traditional report-writing roles will shrink. Process-design decisions, field commissioning, policy interpretation, and negotiations with regulators and companies remain human territory. Engineers who use AI tools are more productive and more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Online oversight through smart environmental platforms
ai_s2_auto: Drafting and template generation for environmental impact assessment reports
Organizing monitoring data and generating reports
ai_s3_list: Process decisions: choose the best route between cost and compliance.
Field commissioning: adjust parameters and diagnose problems from operating data.
Policy judgment: understand the regulatory intent behind new rules.
Stakeholder negotiation: coordinate companies, government agencies, and review experts.
Accountability: take responsibility for a project after signing off on it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates that the information side of environmental engineering is highly compatible with AI. Reports, standards, and monitoring records are text or structured data that AI processes far faster than people. Yet the score of 7 also reflects a limit: in process decisions, field judgment, and compliance accountability, AI can assist but cannot assume responsibility. An engineer's value lies in judgment, not generation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure is both a warning and an opportunity. Let AI draft reports, then use the saved time for process optimization and field commissioning. Environmental engineers who improve efficiency with AI and accept responsibility through professional judgment will be especially sought after.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you study environmental engineering, prepare for a master's degree as a strong foundation because bachelor's graduates often start in technician roles. Build skills in data analysis and environmental regulation. AI tools will replace some writing, but not professional judgment, so deep technical knowledge remains essential.

Learn to use AI for reports and data analysis as soon as possible, and invest the saved time in field commissioning and process experience. Pursue Registered Environmental Engineer certification, which is a strong asset for changing jobs and earning more.

People with backgrounds in chemistry, water supply and drainage, or municipal engineering can transition smoothly into environmental engineering. In interviews, concrete projects and compliance problems you solved are more persuasive than a stack of certificates.

Environmental engineers who can lead projects independently are hard to recruit. Use project-based incentives and certification allowances to retain them, and provide AI-tool training so engineers can spend less time writing reports.

ai_s7_trends: Carbon-reduction goals and smart environmental management are becoming industry priorities, while integrated remediation projects are increasing.
AI is taking over more environmental assessment and reporting work, shifting engineers toward process design and decisions.
Talent shortages are widening in emerging areas such as soil remediation and treatment of emerging contaminants.

body: Environmental Engineers use engineering and scientific methods to solve pollution problems. They design controls for water, air, solid-waste, and soil pollution; conduct environmental impact assessments; manage pollution-control facilities; and audit environmental compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI is getting faster at drafting environmental impact assessments and calculating process parameters, but environmental engineers still decide how a company should remediate a problem and whether an environmental investment is worthwhile.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 写环评初稿、算工艺参数越来越快，但「这家企业的整改方案怎么定、这笔环保投资值不值」，还得环境工程师来拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年环境工程师在岗约 3.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.10 万人，净增约 0.16 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.42 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代环境工程师，但会重构工作方式：环评报告初稿、标准条款检索、监测数据分析这些信息密集型工作正被 AI 大幅加速，传统「写报告」的岗位会萎缩；而工艺设计决策、现场调试、政策解读、与监管部门和企业博弈，依然是人的主场。会用 AI 工具的工程师产能更高，也更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助工艺方案比选
智慧环保平台在线监管
土壤修复效果智能评估
ai_s2_auto: 环评报告初稿与模板生成
环保标准与法规条文检索
监测数据整理与报表生成
排污许可申报材料辅助填报
ai_s3_list: 工艺决策：在成本与达标之间选最优路线。
现场调试：看着数据调参数、找问题。
政策把握：读懂新规背后的监管意图。
多方博弈：协调企业、政府、评审专家。
责任担当：签字就要对项目负责到底。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明环境工程的信息面高度 AI 友好：报告、标准、监测数据都是文本和结构化数据，AI 处理效率远超人工；但 7 分里也藏着一个事实——工艺决策、现场判断和合规责任这些环节，AI 只能辅助不能担责，工程师的价值在「判断」而非「生成」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对你是提醒也是机会：把报告初稿交给 AI，把省下来的时间放在工艺优化和现场调试上；能「用 AI 提效 + 靠判断担责」的环境工程师，会是最抢手的那批。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选环境工程要做好「硕士打底」的准备，本科就业偏技术员；同时把数据分析和环保法规学好，未来 AI 工具会替代撰写、不会替代判断，扎实的专业功底才是立身之本。
尽快掌握 AI 工具做报告和数据分析，把时间投向现场调试和工艺积累；考注册环保工程师，证书是跳槽和提价的硬通货。
有化学、给排水、市政背景的人转环境工程很顺；面试突出「做过哪些具体项目、解决过什么达标难题」，比堆证书更有说服力。
环境工程师难招的是「能独立扛项目」的人，建议用项目分成和持证补贴留人；同时给 AI 工具培训，让工程师从写报告中解放出来。

ai_s7_trends: 双碳与智慧环保成为行业主线，综合整治项目增多。
环评与报告类工作 AI 化，工程师转向工艺与决策。
土壤修复、新污染物治理等新兴领域人才缺口扩大。

body: 环境工程师利用工程与科学手段解决环境污染问题，负责水、气、固废与土壤污染的治理方案设计、环境影响评价、污染处理设施的运行管理及环保合规审核。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 写环评初稿、算工艺参数越来越快，但「这家企业的整改方案怎么定、这笔环保投资值不值」，还得环境工程师来拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An app can generate a plan and count repetitions, but the trainer still decides which muscles should engage, who needs a lighter session today, and how to keep people going.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 370,100 Exercise Trainers And Group Fitness Instructors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 414,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 44,100 jobs, with about 74,200 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $46,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Exercise Trainers And Group Fitness Instructors, but it will handle basic repetition counting and plan generation. Smart equipment and training apps speed up standardized workouts. Trainers can focus on correcting form, protecting clients, motivating them in person, tailoring plans, and building long-term relationships. People who only call out repetitions face pressure, while trainers who coach well and correct form become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Movement recognition and automated form feedback
ai_s3_list: Form correction: people assess posture.
Safety protection: people judge risk.
In-person motivation: people read the room.
Customized plans: people uncover individual needs.
Long-term coaching: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure in fitness training. Systems handle basic counting, while people still lead workouts, correct form, and motivate clients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Systems replace repetition counting and scripted cues, not form correction and safety oversight. Trainers who correct movement and motivate clients become more valuable as tools improve efficiency. Those who only play music and call out repetitions face the most pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with sports or exercise studies, earn a training credential early, and develop form-correction and coaching skills. Basic counting is shrinking in the AI era.
Move beyond leading classes into assessment, plan design, and member retention. Study exercise science and build a base of personal-training clients.
Highlight class volume and renewal rates, and describe the client groups you have served. Fitness facilities value reliability and a strong reputation.
Do not hire based only on physique. Look for trainers who can correct form and motivate clients. Coaches who retain members merit higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Smart equipment becomes widespread, reducing basic coached workouts.
Combining personal training with rehabilitation creates opportunities.
Trainers who correct form and motivate clients are in greater demand.

body: Exercise Trainers And Group Fitness Instructors use exercise science to design programs, lead movements, correct form, and monitor intensity. They help members reach fitness and health goals safely.
career_ai_description_block.heading: An app can generate a plan and count repetitions, but the trainer still decides which muscles should engage, who needs a lighter session today, and how to keep people going.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: App 能出计划数次数，但哪块肌肉该收、谁今天状态差该降量、怎么把人喊坚持，还是教练定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代健身教练，但会分担基础动作计数与计划生成。智能硬件和课程 App 把标准化训练提速，教练从「数个数」挪向「纠错保护、现场激励、定制方案、长期陪伴」。真正被挤掉的是只念口令不纠动作的人，会带人会纠姿的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「数个数念口令」动作，不是「纠姿保护」的岗位。会纠错会激励的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会放音乐喊号子的人。

会纠姿会激励的教练更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI surveillance can track every hand at every table, but supervisors still decide whether to stop play, reassign staff, and calm guests.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 32,500 First Line Supervisors Of Gambling Services Workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 33,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with roughly 3,300 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $61,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace gambling services supervisors, but it will take over much surveillance and screening. Intelligent monitoring, cash tracking, and automated reporting shift supervisors from watching data toward managing people, operations, and compliance. People still maintain order behind the tables, resolve disputes in real time, and manage employees.
ai_s2_accel: AI anti-cheating systems compare game behavior in real time
Facial recognition and tracking assist security management
ai_s2_auto: Automated table surveillance and suspicious-behavior detection
Automated cash and chip transaction reports
Digitized customer profiles and credit records
ai_s3_list: On-site dispatch: assigning staff and tables during peak traffic.
Dispute resolution: calming dissatisfied guests and conflicts in real time.
Employee management: training, evaluating, and monitoring dealer readiness.
Compliance judgment: deciding what to stop and what to report.
Cash and risk awareness: staying alert to anomalies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Automation handles reporting, surveillance, and scheduling workflows. Supervisors retain on-site dispatch, employee management, and dispute resolution. AI provides the eyes for monitoring; supervisors make the decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is manageable. Intelligent surveillance reduces manual screen-watching, but increases the value of supervisors who make management decisions from monitoring results. Leaders who interpret data, understand compliance, and manage people become more valuable as the industry automates.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Gambling is a sensitive, geographically restricted industry and should not be treated as the only career path. If a young person already works in an authorized market, build transferable skills in hotel service and compliance management to preserve options across industries.

Learn intelligent surveillance and compliance audit platforms. Strengthen cash management and dispute resolution. Policy shifts affect this industry, so build transferable management skills alongside specialized experience.

Candidates with front-line service or management experience can enter through a team-lead role. Study rules in legally authorized jurisdictions. Highlight examples of on-site management, cash verification, and dispute resolution on your resume.

Prioritize compliance awareness and control of on-site operations when selecting supervisors. Invest in people-management training alongside intelligent surveillance because staff still stabilize the operation when tools reach their limits.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent surveillance and anti-cheating systems reduce manual screen-watching roles while increasing demand for management positions.
Tighter compliance and anti-money-laundering requirements make compliance management a core qualification for supervisors.
The industry's geographic concentration and policy sensitivity persist, making transferable management skills more durable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代婚姻与家庭治疗师，但会重塑Marriage And Family Therapists的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help review literature and run preliminary analyses, but scientists still decide which hypotheses to propose, how to design experiments, and how to judge causality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 165,300 medical scientists, except epidemiologists, employed in 2024, projected to rise to 179,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 14,300 jobs, with roughly 9,600 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $100,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace medical scientists, but it will reduce the value of routine analysis. AI accelerates literature review and preliminary analysis, shifting scientists from running data toward proposing hypotheses, designing experiments, judging causality, and advancing translation. People who only perform repetitive operations face displacement.
ai_s3_list: Hypothesis generation: people provide insight.
Experimental design: people provide rigor.
Causal judgment: people evaluate evidence.
Translational advancement: people drive implementation.
Reproducibility oversight: people protect integrity.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: An 8/10 score places medical scientists in a high-AI-exposure category. Routine analysis becomes faster, but design and judgment remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces repetitive operations, not hypotheses or experimental design. People who only run data without learning to ask questions face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong quantitative and experimental foundations and learn statistics and omics early. Pure operating work is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from conducting experiments to proposing hypotheses + driving translation, and learn data work and grant applications.
Highlight research projects and publications and specify the translation work you advanced.
Select candidates for design and judgment, not only publication counts.

ai_s7_trends: AI reduces routine analysis.
Demand for translational medicine rises.
Target discovery becomes more sought after.

body: Medical Scientists, Except Epidemiologists conduct basic and translational medical research, design experiments, analyze clinical and omics data, investigate disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets, and advance new drugs and treatments.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help review literature and run preliminary analyses, but scientists still decide which hypotheses to propose, how to design experiments, and how to judge causality.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能辅助读文献和跑初析，但假设怎么提、实验怎么设计、因果怎么判，还是科学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医学科学家（不含流行病学家）在岗约 16.53 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.96 万人，净增约 1.43 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.06 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医学科学家，但会压低常规分析。AI 把文献与初析提速，科学家从「跑数据」挪向「提出假设、实验设计、因果判断与转化推进」。真正被挤的是只做重复操作的人。
ai_s3_list: 假设提出：洞见靠人。
实验设计：严谨靠人。
因果判断：证据靠人。
转化推进：落地靠人。
可重复把关：诚信靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明医学科学家处于高 AI 曝光区——常规分析被加速，但设计与判断还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是重复操作，不是假设与实验设计。怕的是只跑数据、不会提问题的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数理与实验底子打牢，早学统计与组学，AI 时代纯操作在缩。
从「做实验」升级成「提假设 + 转化」，学数据与申报。
突出课题与论文，写明推过哪些转化。
选人看设计与判断，别只看发了多少篇。

ai_s7_trends: AI 压常规分析。
转化医学需求升。
靶点发现更抢手。

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能辅助读文献和跑初析，但假设怎么提、实验怎么设计、因果怎么判，还是科学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can handle grading and lesson materials, but teachers still need to personally support the emotions and concerns of adolescents.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 633,700 middle school teachers, excluding special and career or technical education, were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 621,300 by 2034. That represents roughly 12,400 fewer jobs, with about 40,500 openings per year and median annual pay of approximately $63,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace middle school teachers, but it will free substantial desk time. AI is taking over repetitive work such as lesson preparation, grading, and analysis of student learning that consumes about half of teachers' energy. Yet middle school teaching has never been only about explaining answers correctly. Machines cannot manage classroom discipline, support adolescent emotions, or build trust between families and schools face to face. Teaching that merely reads from textbooks faces elimination, not the teaching profession.
ai_s2_accel: AI precision-teaching systems recommending differentiated exercises
Real-time classroom feedback tools improving interaction
Alerts for unusual student emotions and behavior
ai_s2_auto: Generate initial drafts of lesson materials and lesson plans
Grade assignments and compile student-learning statistics
Generate test papers and analyze results
ai_s3_list: Classroom management and immediate response: energetic adolescent classrooms need a person to maintain order.
Emotional and psychological support: rebellion, disengagement, and family changes require a person who listens.
School-family communication: explain student changes to parents and build trust.
Educational judgment: determine whether grade changes reflect learning methods or emotional condition.
Values guidance: teachers' words and actions are irreplaceable while students form their values.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means desk-based teaching work such as lesson preparation, grading, and analysis has substantial AI exposure, making this a moderately high-exposure occupation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI freeing teachers from mechanical grading is beneficial. Teaching methods that avoid tools and merely recite textbooks face pressure. Teachers who design differentiated instruction and analyze student learning can invest saved time in student development and create greater professional value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study teacher education and earn a teaching credential, but consider subjects with structural shortages, including music, physical education, art, psychology, and information technology, rather than focusing only on Chinese, mathematics, and English. During internships, shadow homeroom teachers to adapt early to adolescent students.

Use AI for lesson preparation and grading, then invest the saved time in learning analysis and individual tutoring. Homeroom teaching is a strong moat. Teachers willing to lead classes and communicate with families are sought after everywhere.

A teaching credential is a firm requirement, and non-education majors need teaching-practice experience. Highlight classroom leadership, communication, and teaching outcomes on your résumé. Private schools and tutoring organizations also provide entry points before pursuing public-school roles.

Do not recruit solely through degrees and written examinations; assess teaching simulations and willingness to lead a homeroom. Provide targeted training in AI teaching tools so teachers can shift from desk tasks toward students and improve educational quality.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Recommend questions based on student learning
Alerts for unusual emotional and behavioral patterns

ai_s7_trends: AI becomes infrastructure for lesson preparation and grading, shifting teachers toward roles as educators and learning designers.
Declining school-age populations intensify, while structural teacher shortages coexist with competition for high-quality schools.
Mental-health and career education enter classrooms, making combined student-development skills a new advantage for teachers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 作业批改和课件交给 AI，但青春期孩子的情绪和心思，还得老师亲自接。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年初中教师（不含特殊与职业技术教育）在岗约 63.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 62.13 万人，岗位净减约 1.24 万个，年均产生约 4.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.30 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代初中教师，但会腾出大量案头时间：备课、批改、学情分析这些占老师一半精力的重复劳动，AI 正在接手。但初中教学的核心从来不只是「把题讲对」——课堂纪律的拿捏、青春期情绪的疏导、家校之间的信任，这些是面对面的活，机器做不了。真正会被淘汰的是「只会照着教材念」的教学方式，而不是教师这个职业。
ai_s2_accel: AI 精准教学系统推送分层练习
课堂即时反馈工具提升互动
学生情绪与行为异常预警
虚拟实验与学科资源库建设
ai_s2_auto: 课件与教案的初稿生成
ai_s3_list: 课堂管理与现场应变：闹腾的青春期课堂需要活人控场。
情感与心理支持：叛逆、厌学、家庭变故，孩子需要的是倾听的人。
家校沟通：把学生的变化讲给家长听，建立信任。
教育判断：成绩波动背后是方法问题还是状态问题，要具体判断。
价值引导：三观形成的年纪，教师言传身教的作用无可替代。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明教学案头工作——备课、批改、分析——的 AI 接触面相当大，属于中高曝光职业。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 把教师从「改作业机器」里解放出来，反而是好事。被挤压的是不会用工具、还停留在念教材阶段的教法；会设计分层教学、会做学情分析的教师，把省下的时间投入育人，职业价值更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当老师就读师范、考教资，但别只盯语数外主科，音体美、心理、信息科技这些结构性缺编学科竞争更小。实习期多跟班主任，早适应青春期的孩子。
把 AI 备课批改用起来，时间省下来做学情分析和个别辅导。班主任工作是护城河，愿意接班主任、会做家校沟通的老师，在哪都抢手。
考教资是硬门槛，非师范生要补齐教学实习。简历突出「能带班、能沟通、有教学成果」，民办校和培训机构也是入口，先上车再往公办跳。
招聘别只看学历与笔试，要看课堂模拟和带班意愿。给会使用 AI 教学工具的教师做专项培训，把他们从案头解放到学生身边，育人质量会明显提升。

ai_s7_trends: AI 成为备课批改基础设施，教师角色向「育人者 + 学习设计师」转型。
学龄人口下行加剧，结构性缺编与优质校竞争并存。
心理健康与生涯教育进课堂，复合育人能力成为教师新优势。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate materials and quotes with one click and generate project renderings, but only an experienced painter has the feel to know whether one final stroke will finish a wall cleanly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 342,200 construction and maintenance painters were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 355,200, a net increase of about 13,000 jobs, with about 28,100 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $48,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace construction painters, but it will take over material calculations and scheduling. AI-powered site measurement, material estimates, automated quotes, and job dispatch are spreading, letting painters shift attention from calculations back to the work itself. Physical tasks such as sanding, painting, and color matching, along with on-site response, cannot be replaced soon. Spray robots handle flat surfaces, not corners and herringbone joints.
ai_s2_accel: Spray robots assisting with large flat surfaces
AR previews showing clients finished painting effects in advance
Smart color-mixing equipment that precisely reproduces color codes
Online job platforms expanding customer reach
ai_s2_auto: AI site measurement and automatic material calculation
Digital work records and acceptance photos
Online search for color cards and color schemes
ai_s3_list: Substrate judgment: deciding which walls can be painted and how much repair they need.
Color matching and touch-ups: making color differences invisible to the naked eye.
Edge and corner details: finishing inside corners, outside corners, and door and window edges.
Material feel: judging putty consistency and paint thickness by hand.
On-site response: adapting to irregular structures and aging substrates.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that manual work and on-site conditions define this trade. Algorithms mainly automate processes such as material calculation, quoting, and scheduling. Every scraping, sanding, painting, and patching motion depends on human feel, while spray robots cover only large flat surfaces.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Painters who use spray robots, smart color matching, and online job platforms work more efficiently, reach more customers, and earn clearly more than those using only traditional hand brushing. Craftsmanship + new tools is the right approach.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learning one trade always provides a livelihood. Painting has quick entry and solid income. Students should apprentice for two years to master substrate preparation and color matching, earn one occupational skill certificate, and advance toward premium finishing and supervision.

Learn new tools such as spray robots and smart color matching, and move toward premium interior finishing and renovation of older homes. Reputation is the greatest asset, so build online job-platform and short-video channels for finding work.

People entering renovation should start as apprentices and first learn putty application and sanding, the fundamentals of painting. Do not rush to contract jobs. Weak craftsmanship makes every contract a loss.
Painter turnover is high. Retain workers through stable schedules + on-time payment + skills training. Experienced painters willing to learn robotic spraying and new materials deserve higher rates.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic area measurement and material calculation
ai_s6_tools.工具: AI site measurement and material calculation tool

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Faster and easier sanding of large surfaces

ai_s7_trends: Renovation and partial remodeling of existing homes are becoming the main growth areas, shifting painters' customers from construction sites to retail clients.
Spray robots cover large flat surfaces, while experienced painters shift toward corner repairs and precision finishing.
As environmentally friendly coatings and new techniques spread, painters who understand and can explain new materials become more popular.

body: Construction and maintenance painters prepare and coat interior and exterior walls, ceilings, doors, windows, and metal components. Their work includes substrate preparation, putty application, sanding, brushing, rolling, spraying, color matching, and touch-ups.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate materials and quotes with one click and generate project renderings, but only an experienced painter has the feel to know whether one final stroke will finish a wall cleanly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一键算出用料和报价，还能生成施工效果图，但墙面那一道「最后一刷收不收得住」的手感，还得靠师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年建筑与维护涂装工在岗约 34.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.52 万人，净增约 1.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.81 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代建筑涂装工，但会接管算料和排期：AI 量房算料、自动报价、派单调度都在普及，涂装工的注意力从「算账」回到「干活」。打磨、刷漆、调色这些物理动作，以及现场应变，机器短时间内替代不了——机器人喷涂能管平面，管不了边角和人字缝。
ai_s2_accel: 喷涂机器人辅助大平面施工
AR 预览让客户提前看到涂装效果
智能调色设备精准复现色号
线上接单平台扩大客源
ai_s2_auto: AI 量房与用料自动计算
报价单与派单调度自动化
施工记录与验收照片电子化
色卡与配色方案在线检索
ai_s3_list: 基层判断：什么样的墙面能刷、要补到什么程度。
调色修补：把色差做到肉眼看不出来。
边角细节：阴角、阳角、门窗边的收口功夫。
用料手感：腻子稠稀、漆的厚薄，全靠手。
现场应变：异形结构和老旧基层的灵活处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行核心是手工与现场，能被算法自动化的主要是算料、报价、排单这些流程；刮、磨、刷、补的每个动作都依赖人的手感，机器人喷涂只覆盖大平面。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零变化：会用喷涂机器人、智能调色和线上接单的涂装工，效率高、客户来源广，收入明显高于只会纯手刷的老办法。手艺 + 新工具，才是这行的正确姿势。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学一门手艺永远有饭吃。涂装工入行快、收入不低，建议孩子先跟师傅学两年，把基层处理和调色练扎实；考个职业技能证书，往精装和监理方向走。
学喷涂机器人、智能调色这些新工具，往高端精装和旧房改造走。口碑是最大的资产，接单平台和短视频接活渠道要经营起来。
想转行进装修，从学徒干起，先学刮腻子和打磨，这是涂装的基本功。别急着包活，手艺不过硬，包多少亏多少。
涂装工流动性大，用「稳定工期 + 按时结款 + 技能培训」留人；愿意学机器人喷涂和新材料的师傅，值得给更高工价。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 面积测量与用料自动计算

ai_s7_trends: 存量房翻新与局改成为主要增量，涂装工客源从工地转向零售。
喷涂机器人覆盖大平面，师傅转向边角修补与精细工艺。
环保涂料与新工艺普及，会新材料、能讲解的涂装工更受欢迎。

body: 建筑与维护涂装工负责建筑物内外墙面、天花板、门窗与金属构件的表面处理与涂装，包括基层处理、刮腻子、打磨、刷涂滚涂喷涂与调色修补。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一键算出用料和报价，还能生成施工效果图，但墙面那一道「最后一刷收不收得住」的手感，还得靠师傅。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI customer service can answer ten thousand questions, but an attendant still has to help an older passenger find the right platform and soothe a crying child.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 25,600 passenger attendants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 26,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,200 jobs, with about 4,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $37,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace passenger attendants, but it will take over processes such as ticketing, announcements, and passenger-flow statistics. The core of passenger service is the person on site who solves immediate problems and stabilizes situations during emergencies. Machines cannot replace this face-to-face service. Roles will shift from operating ticketing systems toward managing service and safety.
ai_s2_accel: AI customer service and station robot guidance
Intelligent dispatch linked to attendant scheduling
ai_s2_auto: Electronic ticket verification and self-service gates
Automation of passenger-flow statistics and dispatch information
Intelligent customer-service routing for common inquiries
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face service: inquiries, assistance, and reassurance all happen on site.
Emergency response: real-time handling of passenger illness, crowding, and stampede risks.
Large-crowd organization: keep passenger flow orderly and calm.
Human warmth in service: assist older adults, children, and priority passengers.
Communication and adaptability: defuse difficult questions and emotional passengers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 means that automation is taking over processes such as ticketing, announcements, and statistics, but the core of attendant service is on-site interaction and safety response. These face-to-face tasks depend heavily on people, limiting AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure still brings change. Self-service equipment and intelligent customer service divert mechanical tasks, requiring attendants to develop into combined service + safety + experience roles. Staff who understand emergency response and provide good service gain rather than lose value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter railway, aviation, or other passenger transport systems, meet both education and service-etiquette requirements. Research each company's recruiting channel and prepare to work when your family is on holiday. Communication and resilience matter more than credentials in service work.

Master emergency drills and priority-passenger service, and proactively participate in team management and new-line launch preparations. Advancement to train conductor, station duty manager, or passenger transport manager improves both income and stability.

Experience in hotels, supermarkets, retail, or other service settings transfers well to passenger transport. In interviews, emphasize service examples and emergency-response experience. For stable establishment-based employment, monitor recruitment by state-owned railways, metro operators, and similar organizations.

Hire attendants for their willingness to serve and adaptability, not accumulated credentials. Institutionalize holiday scheduling and psychological support, because service roles quickly burn out when they rely only on personal dedication.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Scan for verification and pass through gates automatically
Automatically trigger arrival and safety announcements
Automated answers to frequently asked questions

ai_s7_trends: As self-service ticket checks and intelligent customer service spread, attendants shift from ticketing operations toward service and safety.
Expansion of high-speed rail networks and passenger demand keeps job supply stable.
Service experience + emergency response become the core assessment dimensions for attendant roles.

body: Passenger attendants provide boarding and alighting organization, guidance and consultation, ticket verification, and onboard service in railway, aviation, rail transit, and road passenger settings. They deliver safety instructions and emergency response as direct service providers in public transportation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 客服能回答一万个问题，但「这位老人要去哪个站台、那个孩子哭了怎么哄」，还得乘务员在现场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年乘客服务员在岗约 2.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.68 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代乘客服务员，但会接管票务、广播、客流统计等流程环节。客运服务的核心是「现场的人」：帮旅客解决当下的问题、在突发里稳住局面，这些面对面服务机器替代不了。岗位会从「操作票务」转向「经营服务与安全」。
ai_s2_accel: 人脸识别进站与无感通行
AI 客服与车站机器人引导
智能调度联动乘务排班
可穿戴设备辅助现场联络
ai_s2_auto: 电子客票核验与自助检票
自动广播与信息发布系统
客流统计与调度信息自动化
常见问询的智能客服分流
ai_s3_list: 面对面服务：问询、帮助、安抚都是现场活。
突发处置：旅客疾病、拥挤踩踏的临场应对。
大客流组织：把人流安排得有序不慌乱。
服务温度：帮老扶幼、照顾重点旅客。
沟通应变：刁钻问题与情绪旅客的化解。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明票务、广播、统计等流程正被自动化接管，但乘务服务的核心是「现场互动与安全处置」，这些面对面环节高度依赖人，AI 替代度有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：自助设备和智能客服分流了机械业务，乘务员要向「服务 + 安全 + 体验」复合角色升级。懂应急、会服务的乘务人员，岗位价值不降反升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进铁路、航空等客运体系，学历和服务礼仪都要过关。建议先了解各公司招录通道，做好节假日不能陪家人的准备；服务行业对沟通和抗压的要求，比学历更实在。
把应急演练、重点旅客服务做扎实，主动参与班组管理和新线开通筹备。向列车长、值班站长、客运主任晋升，是收入和稳定性双提升的路径。
有酒店、商超、零售等服务经验的转客运很顺；面试突出你的服务案例和突发处置经历。想要稳定编制可以关注铁路、地铁等国企招录。
招乘务重服务意愿和应变力，轻学历堆砌；节假日排班制度化和心理支持要跟上，服务岗最怕用爱发电耗光热情。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 到站与安全广播自动触发

ai_s7_trends: 自助检票与智能客服普及，乘务员从票务操作转向服务与安全。
高铁网络与客运需求扩张，岗位供给保持稳定。
「服务体验 + 应急处置」成为乘务岗的核心考核维度。

body: 乘客服务员在铁路、航空、轨道与公路客运场景中为旅客提供乘降组织、引导咨询、票务核验与车厢服务，执行安全提示与应急处置，是公共交通服务链条上的直接服务者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can instantly generate exercises and derivations, but teachers still determine where students are truly stuck and which frontier questions deserve research.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 17,100 postsecondary physics teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 17,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 1,300 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $97,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary physics teachers, but it will assist teaching and questions. Question banks, courseware, and tutoring assistants accelerate routine instruction, shifting teachers from presenting knowledge toward research leadership, classroom guidance, academic judgment, and student mentorship. Lecture-only instructors who merely read PPT slides will be displaced, while people with research and guidance skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: AI question generation and automated grading
ai_s3_list: Research topic selection: depends on people.
Classroom guidance: depends on experience.
Academic judgment: depends on training.
Graduate supervision: depends on people.
Frontier intuition: depends on deep investigation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed teaching-assistant field. Systems accelerate question generation and answers, but research and guidance still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is routine question answering and exercise creation, not research and teaching leadership. Teachers who publish and mentor become scarcer as efficiency rises. Lecture-only instructors who merely read PPT slides face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with an undergraduate physics degree and join a research group early. Pure lecturing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop research and communication early.
Advance from teaching to research + guidance, use AI to improve efficiency, and pursue more publications and team leadership.
Emphasize research outputs and teaching evaluations, and specify your field. Universities value recognized credentials and stability.
When hiring, assess more than lecturing; look for research judgment. Professors who provide intellectual leadership deserve resources.

ai_s7_trends: AI teaching assistants spread, reducing routine questions.
Research competition depends more heavily on output.
Teachers who conduct research and guide students are more sought after.

body: Postsecondary physics teachers teach physics at higher education institutions, supervise laboratories and degree theses, conduct and publish frontier research, and participate in discipline development, grant applications, and academic service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can instantly generate exercises and derivations, but teachers still determine where students are truly stuck and which frontier questions deserve research.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒出习题和推导步骤，但哪块学生真卡住了、前沿该怎么选题，还是教师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校物理教师在岗约 1.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.75 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校物理教师，但会辅助教学与答疑。题库、课件与答疑助手把常规教学提速，教师从「讲知识点」挪向「科研引领、课堂引导、学术判断、带学生」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的授课型，有科研与引导力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 科研选题：靠人。
课堂引导：靠经验。
学术判断：靠练。
带研究生：靠人。
前沿直觉：靠钻。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的助教区——出题答疑被系统加速，但科研与引导还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规答疑与出题」动作，不是「科研与教学引领」的岗位。有学术产出、能带人的教师，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只念 PPT 的授课型。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 物理本科打底，早点进组做科研。AI 时代纯讲课在缩，早点练科研和表达。
从「授课」升级成「科研 + 引导」，用 AI 提效，争取多发论文带团队。
突出科研产出与教学评价，写清方向。高校看重帽子与稳。
选人别只看讲课，要看有没有科研脑子。能引领的教授，值得给资源。

ai_s7_trends: AI 助教普及，答疑缩。
科研竞争更靠产出。
会科研能引导的教师更抢手。

body: 高校物理教师在高等院校讲授物理课程，指导实验与学位论文，开展物理前沿科学研究并发表论文，参与学科建设、基金申请与学术服务。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒出习题和推导步骤，但哪块学生真卡住了、前沿该怎么选题，还是教师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Imaging AI can measure a bunion angle with millimeter precision, but the physician's hands still determine how far to use the drill and how to fit the orthotic.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 9,700 podiatrists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 9,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 300 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $152,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace podiatrists, but it will assist image interpretation and orthotic design. Image recognition and structured records accelerate repetitive work, shifting physicians from measuring angles toward physical examinations, minimally invasive procedures, and chronic disease management. People limited to simple nail care will be displaced, while those who perform surgery and manage diabetic feet become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Decision support suggests diagnostic and treatment pathways
ai_s2_auto: Automatic measurement and annotation of foot images
Structured generation of medical records and prescriptions
Initial parameter design for orthotic insoles
ai_s3_list: Physical examination feel: foot structure must be palpated.
Minimally invasive procedures: people control drill depth.
Chronic disease management: people monitor diabetic feet.
Surgical decisions: people determine indications.
Patient communication: older adults need personal explanations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed support field. Systems accelerate image interpretation and design, but procedural treatment remains human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is measuring angles and writing records, not hands-on foot treatment. Podiatrists who perform surgery and manage diabetic feet become scarcer as screening expands. Those limited to simple nail care face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Prepare for lengthy training before entering this field and pursue a DPM after your bachelor's degree. Simple nail care is shrinking in the AI era, so develop surgery and diabetic foot management early.
Advance from a nail-care clinic to surgery + diabetic foot management, study imaging and orthotics, and pursue subspecialty training.
Emphasize specialty procedures and chronic disease management, and specify the procedures you have performed. Clinics value reliability and precision.
When hiring, assess more than education; look for precision hands-on skills. People who independently perform surgery and manage diabetic feet deserve higher revenue shares.

ai_s7_trends: Demand for diabetic foot management grows steadily.
3D custom insoles and gait analysis become widespread.
Podiatrists who perform surgery and manage chronic disease are more sought after.

body: Podiatrists specialize in foot and ankle conditions. Through physical examinations, imaging, and laboratory tests, they diagnose deformities, injuries, and chronic diseases; provide medication, minimally invasive, and orthotic treatment; operate when necessary; and help patients restore walking and lower-limb function.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Imaging AI can measure a bunion angle with millimeter precision, but the physician's hands still determine how far to use the drill and how to fit the orthotic.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 影像 AI 能把拇外翻角度量得毫厘不差，但钻头像削到哪、垫要怎么垫，还是医生手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年足病医生在岗约 0.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.99 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 15.28 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代足病医生，但会辅助读片与矫形设计。影像识别和病历结构化把重复工作提速，医生从「量角度」挪向「查体操作、微创治疗、慢病管理」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单修甲的，能手术能管糖足的更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 远程随访与创面拍照识别
决策支持提示诊疗路径
ai_s2_auto: 足部影像的自动测量与标注
病历与处方的结构化生成
矫形鞋垫的初步参数设计
糖尿病足风险的自动筛查
ai_s3_list: 查体手感：足部结构靠摸。
微创操作：钻头深浅靠人。
慢病管理：糖足靠人盯。
手术决策：指征靠人定。
医患沟通：老人要人讲。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的辅助区——读片与设计被系统加速，但操作治疗留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「量角度写病历」动作，不是「动手治脚」的岗位。能手术能管糖足的足病医生，反而随筛查普及更稀缺。怕的是只做简单修甲的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这行先备长培养的心理，本科后考 DPM。AI 时代简单修甲在缩，早点练手术和糖足管理。
从「修甲门诊」升级成「手术 + 糖足管理」，学影像和矫形，争取亚专进修。
突出专科操作和慢病管理，写清做过的术式。诊所看重稳和细。
招人别只看学历，要看动手细不细。能独立手术管糖足的，值得给高分成。

ai_s7_trends: 糖尿病足管理需求稳增。
3D 定制鞋垫与步态分析普及。
能手术能管慢病的足病医更抢手。

body: 足病医生是专注于足与踝部疾病的专科医师，通过查体、影像与实验室检查诊断畸形、损伤与慢性病，实施药物、微创与矫形治疗，必要时手术，帮助患者恢复行走与下肢功能。
