ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor ten thousand parameters at once and issue early warnings, but the person in the control room still decides whether an alert is false or signals a real abnormality and whether the unit must be shut down immediately.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 31,600 power plant operators were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 28,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 3,600 jobs, with approximately 2,500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $99,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not fully replace power plant operators. Unit startups and shutdowns, emergency response, and field inspections require experienced people who understand the equipment, and only people can bear responsibility for power supply safety. AI systems can take over routine monitoring and data records, but critical decisions and on-site judgments still depend on operators.
ai_s2_accel: AI early warnings of abnormal parameter trends
Assistance from intelligent inspection robots and sensors
Integrated operation of digital power plant systems
ai_s2_auto: Automatic collection and monitoring of operating parameters
Automatic generation of operating logs and reports
Automatic recording of equipment condition data
ai_s3_list: Abnormality judgment: distinguish false alarms from real problems.
Incident response: stabilize conditions quickly according to procedures.
On-site feel: assess equipment by sound and temperature.
Coordination: work with dispatch and maintenance teams.
Accountability: provide final assurance for power supply safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means AI is clearly involved in the role but cannot replace its core. Automation is taking over monitoring, records, and routine adjustments, while abnormal-event response, unit operations, and field judgment still depend on human experience and responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure makes adaptation essential. Operators who understand digital power plants and AI monitoring systems can move into higher-level operations analysis roles, while those who cling to old procedures and avoid new systems will see their value continue to shrink.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter a power plant, study power systems, thermal power engineering, electrical automation, or a related field, preferably through an industry-recognized institution or a targeted training program with a plant. Explain clearly that stability is an advantage, but shift work and assessment pressure are real.

Move toward intelligent operations: learn digital power plant systems and AI monitoring and alert tools, and understand operating logic after renewable energy integration. Above shift-supervisor level, advancement depends not only on seniority but also on mastery of new technology systems.

People with electrical or electromechanical backgrounds can pursue operations roles at power plants and energy companies. In interviews, emphasize respect for procedures, emergency-response reasoning, and adaptability to shifts, which often matter more than academic credentials.

Difficulty recruiting and retaining operations staff is common. Retain people through clear advancement paths + technical training + shift allowances. Equip experienced operators with digital tools so veteran knowledge becomes system knowledge.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Replace people in high-temperature and high-pressure areas
Coordination of load and grid-connection instructions
Automatic generation of logs and reports

ai_s7_trends: Large-scale renewable integration creates more complex coordination scenarios for operations roles.
As digital power plants and AI warnings spread, operations roles are shifting toward analysis.
Safety and assessment requirements continue to tighten, with stricter certification and procedural compliance.

body: Power plant operators monitor generating units in plant control rooms or in the field, adjust loads and operating parameters, perform unit startups and shutdowns, and respond to incidents. They ensure boilers, turbines, generators, and other equipment operate safely and steadily and maintain a reliable power supply.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor ten thousand parameters at once and issue early warnings, but the person in the control room still decides whether an alert is false or signals a real abnormality and whether the unit must be shut down immediately.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能同时盯一万个参数还能提前报警，但「这个报警是误报还是真异常、要不要立刻停机」——最后拍板的还是控制室里的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电力操作员在岗约 3.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.80 万人，岗位净减约 0.36 万个，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会完全取代电力操作员：机组启停、事故处置、现场巡检这些环节必须由懂设备、有经验的人执行，供电安全的责任更是只能由人来担。AI 系统能接管常规监控与数据记录，但关键时刻的决断和现场的判断，依然靠操作员。
ai_s2_accel: AI 提前预警参数异常趋势
智能巡检机器人与传感器辅助
数字化电厂系统集成运行
AI 辅助事故复盘与培训
ai_s2_auto: 运行参数自动采集与监控
运行日志与报表自动生成
设备状态数据自动记录
ai_s3_list: 异常判断：区分误报与真异常。
事故处置：按规程快速稳定局面。
现场手感：听声看温判断设备状态。
协调沟通：与调度、检修的配合。
责任担当：供电安全的最终把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明电力操作员是「AI 明显介入、但替代不了核心」的岗位：监控、记录和常规调节正被自动化系统接管，而异常处置、机组操作和现场判断，依然依赖人的经验和责任。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光更要跟上变化：懂数字化电厂和 AI 监控系统的操作员，会转向更高级的「运行分析」角色；只守旧流程、不学新系统的人，岗位价值会持续缩水。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进电厂，选电力系统、热能动力、电气自动化等专业，尽量进行业认可的院校和电厂定向培养项目。要跟孩子讲清楚：稳定是好事，但倒班和考核压力是真实的。
往智能化方向走：学数字化电厂系统、AI 监控告警工具，掌握新能源并网后的运行逻辑。值长以上岗位拼的不只是资历，还有对新技术体系的掌握。
有电气、机电背景的可以关注电厂和能源企业的运行岗。面试时强调对规程的敬畏、应急处置的思路和倒班适应力，这些比学历更能打动招聘方。
运行岗难招难留是常态，用「明确的晋升通道 + 技术培训 + 倒班补贴」留人。给有经验的操作员配数字化工具，让老师傅的经验沉淀成系统知识。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 高温高压区域替代人工

ai_s7_trends: 新能源大规模并网，运行岗位面临更复杂的协调场景。
数字化电厂与 AI 预警普及，运行岗向分析型转型。
安全与考核要求持续收紧，持证与规程执行更严格。

body: 电力操作员在电厂控制室或现场监控发电机组运行，调节负荷与运行参数，执行机组启停和事故处置，确保锅炉、汽轮机、发电机等设备安全稳定运行并保障供电可靠。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能同时盯一万个参数还能提前报警，但「这个报警是误报还是真异常、要不要立刻停机」——最后拍板的还是控制室里的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can detect bearing problems in vibration data, but a repairer still crawls under the car and replaces the worn axle.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 17,900 rail car repairers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 18,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with approximately 1,500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $65,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace rail car repairers, but it will change diagnostic methods. Condition monitoring, data analysis, and fault prediction clarify what needs repair, allowing workers to focus on execution and response. Under-car disassembly skills and comprehensive field judgment remain difficult to replace.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time diagnosis through onboard condition monitoring
AI fault prediction and health management
ai_s2_auto: Electronic repair work orders and fault records
Software management of spare parts and tools
Digital repair processes and work instructions
ai_s3_list: Under-car craftsmanship: machines cannot replace hands in disassembly, adjustment, and measurement.
Comprehensive fault diagnosis: when data shows an abnormality, people still determine what it is and how to repair it.
Safety responsibility and procedures: people uphold every step of railway safety.
Field adaptability: experience handles temporary faults and emergency repairs.
Rigor with gauges and processes: a difference of one millimeter creates a safety risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects that most work occurs on site. Software is taking over standardized records and management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still brings change. As condition-based maintenance and AI diagnostics spread, pure routine inspection roles decline, while repairers who fix equipment, diagnose problems, and interpret data are in greater demand. Process-only work without underlying knowledge faces compression.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Attend a railway or electromechanical technical school or vocational college and emphasize hands-on work and drawing interpretation. Maintenance in the AI era requires data literacy, so build strong electrical and braking-system knowledge for long-term growth after entering the system.

Learn condition monitoring and intelligent diagnostic tools and advance from scheduled maintenance to condition-based maintenance + data analysis. Earn technician and senior technician levels and move toward technical management and training.

People with mechanical or electrical maintenance experience have an advantage when transitioning through railway-system or rail-vehicle factory repair roles. A resume describing vehicle types maintained and faults resolved is more persuasive than general claims of hands-on ability.

Test repair candidates on safety procedures + diagnostic reasoning by presenting a fault symptom and asking how they would investigate it. Repairers who interpret data, follow procedures, and possess strong craft skills deserve higher skill grades.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Vibration and temperature monitoring, abnormality alarms

ai_s7_trends: Condition-based maintenance and AI diagnostics become mainstream, shifting from scheduled to on-demand maintenance.
As high-speed trains and intelligent maintenance spread, repairers combine data and electrical skills.
Tighter railway safety standards make skill levels and certification decisive career boundaries.

body: Rail car repairers inspect, repair, and maintain passenger and freight rail cars and high-speed trainsets, including braking, bogie, coupler, electrical, and other systems. They are key technical workers protecting railway safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can detect bearing problems in vibration data, but a repairer still crawls under the car and replaces the worn axle.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从振动数据里听出轴承的毛病，但钻进车底换下那根磨蚀的车轴，还是维修工的活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年铁路车辆在岗约 1.79 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.84 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.15 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代铁路车辆维修工，但会改变诊断方式。状态监测、数据分析和故障预测让「该修什么」更清楚，维修工把时间花在执行和处置上。真正难以替代的，是车下的拆装手艺和现场的综合判断。
ai_s2_accel: 车载状态监测实时诊断
AI 故障预测与健康管理
图像识别辅助部件检查
ai_s2_auto: 检修工单与故障记录的电子化
备件库存与工具的软件管理
检修流程与工艺卡的数字化
车辆技术档案的数据化管理
ai_s3_list: 车下作业手艺：拆装、调整、测量，机器替不了手。
综合故障诊断：数据报异常，还要人判断是什么、怎么修。
安全责任与规程：铁路安全的每一道工序都是人守住的。
现场应变：临时故障、抢修任务，靠的是经验。
量具与工艺的严谨：差一个毫米，就是不安全。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在现场作业，能被标准化的环节是记录和管理，这些正在被软件接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零变化：状态修和 AI 诊断普及后，纯例行检查岗会减少，但能修、能诊断、会看数据的维修工更抢手。被压缩的是只会按流程走、不懂原理的作业方式。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走铁路或机电类技校、职业院校，重视动手和图纸阅读。AI 时代检修要会看数据，把电气、制动原理学扎实，进系统后发展空间大。
把状态监测和智能诊断工具学起来，从「定期修」升级到「状态修 + 数据分析」。考技师、高级技师，往技术管理和培训方向走。
有机械、电气维修经验的转型有优势，从铁路系统或车辆厂的检修岗位切入。简历上写「检修过什么车型、处理过什么故障」，比泛泛的动手能力强更有说服力。
招检修工要考「安全规程 + 诊断思路」：给一个故障现象问怎么排查。会看数据、守规程、手艺过硬的维修工，值得给更高技能等级。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 振动温度监测、异常报警

ai_s7_trends: 状态修与 AI 诊断成为主流，从「定期修」转向「按需修」。
动车组与智能化检修普及，维修工向数据与电气复合方向升级。
铁路安全标准趋严，技能等级与持证成为职业分水岭。

body: 铁路车辆维修工负责铁路客货车辆与动车组的检查、维修与保养，涵盖制动、转向架、车钩、电气等系统，是保障铁路运输安全的关键技术岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能从振动数据里听出轴承的毛病，但钻进车底换下那根磨蚀的车轴，还是维修工的活。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Platforms can generate automated valuations, but brokers still decide which property is worth recommending, how to build agreement, and how to negotiate financing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 111,300 real estate brokers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 115,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,700 jobs, with about 9,700 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $72,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace real estate brokers, but it will reduce standard property showings. Online listings and automated valuations accelerate routine comparisons, shifting brokers from showing volume to complex dealmaking, local relationship development, and closing support. Brokers who only conduct standard showings are most vulnerable, while those who cultivate business and close deals become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Deal negotiation: people negotiate agreement.
Local business development: people build relationships.
Complex transactions: people make tradeoffs.
Closing support: people guide the process.
Long-term trust: people build confidence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate standard showings, but people retain their role in dealmaking and local business development.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard showings are being replaced, not closing transactions. Brokers who cultivate business and close deals become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only maximize showing volume face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in sales or marketing, practice local networking and negotiation. Pure showings are shrinking in the AI era, so develop dealmaking skills early.
Advance from showings to developing solutions + cultivating clients, and learn financing and closing processes.
Highlight performance and local resources and specify the neighborhoods you covered.
When hiring, look beyond speaking ability to dealmaking judgment. Core professionals who cultivate major clients deserve higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: As platforms spread, standard work shrinks.
Complex transactions create opportunities.
Brokers with business-development ability are more sought after.

body: Real estate brokers facilitate property sales and rentals, coordinate clients and listings, negotiate prices and transaction processes, use local knowledge and negotiation to close deals, and support completion of title transfers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Platforms can generate automated valuations, but brokers still decide which property is worth recommending, how to build agreement, and how to negotiate financing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 平台能自动估价，但哪套值得推、怎么讲成一致、贷款怎么谈，还是经纪定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年房地产经纪人在岗约 11.13 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.50 万人，净增约 0.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.97 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.23 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代房产经纪人，但会压缩标准带看。线上房源与自动估价把常规比价提速，经纪从「带看量」挪向「撮合复杂交易、本地经营、过户护航」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准带看的人，有经营力能撮合的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 撮合谈判：一致靠人谈。
本地经营：关系靠人养。
复杂交易：取舍靠人。
过户护航：流程靠人。
长期信任：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——标准带看被系统加速，但撮合与本地经营还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准带看」动作，不是「撮合成交」的岗位。有经营力、能撮合的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会带看量。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 销售/市场起步多练本地与谈判，AI 时代纯带看在缩，早点练撮合。
从「带看」升级成「做方案 + 养客户」，学贷款与过户。
突出业绩和本地资源，写清跟过哪些片区。
选人别只看口才，要看有没有撮合脑子。能养大客户的骨干值得给高佣。

ai_s7_trends: 平台普及，标准缩。
复杂交易带来机会。
有经营力的经纪更抢手。

body: 房地产经纪人撮合房产买卖与租赁，统筹客源房源、议价与交易流程，运用本地知识与谈判达成成交并跟进过户落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 平台能自动估价，但哪套值得推、怎么讲成一致、贷款怎么谈，还是经纪定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sawing lines can replace repetitive cutting passes, but operators still change blades, adjust fences, inspect wood, and judge abnormalities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 45,000 wood sawing machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 44,700 by 2034, a net loss of about 300 jobs, with about 4,800 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $40,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace the entire occupation, but it will reduce simple operating work. CNC systems and automated sorting accelerate standard cuts, moving operators from feeding material toward machine setup, material assessment, troubleshooting, and tending multiple machines. Push-button-only roles face displacement, while people who set up machines and exercise judgment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Machine setup and blade installation: people provide feel.
Material assessment: people read grain.
Troubleshooting: people clear jams.
Quality control: people inspect cut surfaces.
Safety monitoring: people remain on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in machining with moderately high AI exposure. Systems accelerate standard cuts, but people remain essential for setup and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces pure push-button operation, not combined setup + material assessment + troubleshooting roles. People with practical feel and judgment become scarcer as automation spreads.

ai_s5_persona.建议: At secondary vocational or technical school, practice measuring tools and machine setup. Simple material feeding is shrinking, so develop judgment early.
Advance from pressing buttons to machine setup + multi-machine tending by learning CNC fundamentals.
Highlight equipment experience and the ability to assess wood, and list the machine models you have operated.
Do not hire based only on strength; evaluate machine setup and drawing-reading skills.

ai_s7_trends: CNC lines are spreading, reducing simple jobs.
Opportunities are growing in setup and multi-machine tending.
People with sound judgment are in greater demand.

body: Wood sawing machine setters and operators install, adjust, and tend sawing equipment to cut logs and boards precisely to specification while monitoring feeding, blade condition, and quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated sawing lines can replace repetitive cutting passes, but operators still change blades, adjust fences, inspect wood, and judge abnormalities.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动锯切线能替重复走刀，但换刀、调靠山、看料和异常判断还是操作工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、木材在岗约 4.50 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.47 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代整个岗位，但会压缩简单操作。数控与自动分选把标准走刀提速，操作工从「纯走料」挪向「调机、看料、异常处理、多机看管」。真正被挤掉的是只按按钮的，会调机能判断的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 调机装刀：手感靠人。
看料判断：纹理靠人。
异常处理：卡料靠人。
质量把关：切面靠人。
安全值守：现场靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的机加工区——标准走刀被系统加速，但调机与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯按钮操作」，不是「调机 + 看料 + 异常」的复合岗。有手感能判断的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中职/技校起步多练量具和调机，纯走料在缩，早点练判断。
从「按按钮」升级成「调机 + 多机看管」，学数控基础。
突出设备经验和看料能力，写清跟过哪些机型。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会调机、能不能看图。

ai_s7_trends: 数控线普及，简单岗缩。
调机多机看管机会增。
会判断的人更抢手。

body: 木材锯切机设置工/操作员负责安装、调试并看管锯切设备，将原木与板材按规格精准锯切，监控进料、刀口与质量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动锯切线能替重复走刀，但换刀、调靠山、看料和异常判断还是操作工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring systems can count students, but school bus monitors still decide which child is misbehaving, how to calm the entire bus, and how to handle emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 71,400 school bus monitors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 69,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,900 jobs, with approximately 12,600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $35,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace school bus monitors, but it will reduce standardized roles. Onboard monitoring and automated attendance speed up routine recordkeeping, shifting monitors from counting heads toward on-site supervision, emergency response, and emotional reassurance. People who only take attendance will be displaced, while those who can supervise children and maintain order will become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Tap cards for boarding and exiting
ai_s3_list: On-site supervision: people monitor safety.
Emergency response: people stabilize the situation.
Emotional reassurance: people calm crying or distressed children.
Discipline management: people exercise judgment and restraint.
Boarding and exiting assistance: people extend a helping hand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a medium AI-exposure category. Systems accelerate attendance and records, but supervision and response remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Attendance and recordkeeping tasks are being replaced, not roles centered on on-site supervision. As efficiency improves, people who can supervise children and maintain order become even scarcer. Monitors who only count heads without watching safety face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in school-crossing support or as a teaching assistant and gain experience in supervision and emergency response. Attendance-only work is contracting in the AI era, so develop response skills early.
Advance from counting heads to supervision and emergency response; learn safety and communication.
Highlight attention to detail and route experience, clearly stating which schools you have served. Bus fleets value steadiness and precision.
Do not hire solely on low cost; assess whether candidates are careful and composed. Core personnel who can supervise children are worth retaining.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Replace watching the rear of the bus

ai_s7_trends: As onboard monitoring becomes widespread, attendance duties shrink.
Supervision and response create opportunities.
Monitors who can maintain order are in greater demand.

body: School Bus Monitors assist school bus drivers in keeping students safe on the way to and from school. They take attendance, supervise students, maintain discipline, and respond to incidents as the on-site guardians of student transportation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Monitoring systems can count students, but school bus monitors still decide which child is misbehaving, how to calm the entire bus, and how to handle emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监控能点数，但哪个孩子闹、怎么稳全车、突发怎么处置，还是监督员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年校车监督员在岗约 7.14 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.95 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 1.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.50 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代校车监督员，但会压缩标准岗。车载监控与自动点名把常规记录提速，监督员从「数人头」挪向「现场看护、突发处置、情绪安抚」。真正被挤掉的是只做点名的，会看护、能稳场的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场看护：安全靠人盯。
突发处置：稳住靠人。
情绪安抚：哭闹靠人。
纪律管理：分寸靠人。
上下车护送：手靠人伸。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——点名记录被系统加速，但看护与处置仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「点名记录」动作，不是「现场看护」的岗位。会看护、能稳场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只数人头、不盯安全的监督员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护学/助教起步多练看护和应急，AI 时代纯点名在缩，早点练处置。
从「数人头」升级成「做看护 + 处置」，学安全和沟通。
突出细心和线路经验，写清跟过哪些学校。车队看重稳和细。
选人别只看便宜，要看细不细、稳不稳。能看护的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 车载监控普及，点名缩。
看护与处置带来机会。
会稳场的监督员更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can portion meat automatically, but workers still decide how to make each cut and assign grades.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 69,600 slaughterers and meat packers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 71,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with approximately 8,400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $39,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace slaughterers and meat packers, but it will reduce standardized roles. Automated cutting lines and robots speed up routine work, shifting workers from cutting standard portions to skilled cutting and grading, sanitation control, and exception handling. Standardized stations face displacement, while people who understand cutting and grading are better positioned.
ai_s3_list: Cutting and grading: people make the cuts.
Sanitation control: people protect the baseline.
Exception response: people make the tradeoffs.
Complex areas: people make the judgment.
Apprenticeship: people pass down the craft.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates medium-high exposure. Systems accelerate some processes, but people retain a role wherever judgment and accountability are required.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is cutting standard portions, not skilled cutting and grading roles. People with strong cutting and grading skills become even scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The harshest parts of the field are shrinking. Develop cutting and grading skills early, as purely standardized stations decline in the AI era.
Advance from cutting portions to skilled cutting + grading, and learn sanitation and quality inspection.
Highlight consistency and a low injury rate. Plants value stability and speed.
Do not assess candidates only on speed; evaluate cutting technique and sanitation. Core staff deserve premium positions.

ai_s7_trends: Automated cutting is spreading, reducing workstations.
Cutting and grading skills create opportunities.
Workers who understand grading are better positioned.

body: Slaughterers and Meat Packers slaughter livestock and poultry and cut and package meat. They coordinate production lines, sanitation, and grading and use cutting skills and procedures to produce compliant meat products.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robots can portion meat automatically, but workers still decide how to make each cut and assign grades.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能自动分割，但刀工怎么下、分级怎么定，还是工人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年屠宰与肉类包装工在岗约 6.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.12 万人，净增约 0.16 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.84 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.98 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代屠宰与包装工，但会压缩标准岗。自动分割线与机器人把常规活提速，工人从「切标准块」挪向「刀工分级、卫生把关、异常处理」。真正被挤掉的是纯标准工位，懂刀工、能分级的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 刀工分级：下刀靠人。
卫生把关：底线靠人。
异常处置：取舍靠人。
复杂部位：判断靠人。
师徒传授：手艺靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「切标准块」动作，不是「刀工与分级」的岗位。有刀工力、能分级的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行艰苦在被压缩，早点练刀工和分级，AI 时代纯工位在缩。
从「切块」升级成「刀工 + 分级」，学卫生与质检。
突出稳定与低伤，厂里看重稳和快。
选人别只看快，看刀工和卫生，骨干值得给档口。

ai_s7_trends: 自动分割普及，工位缩。
刀工分级带来机会。
懂分级的工更稳。

body: 屠宰与肉类包装工主导畜禽的屠宰与分割包装，统筹流水线、卫生与分级，运用刀工与规范手段，产出达标肉品落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机器人能自动分割，但刀工怎么下、分级怎么定，还是工人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize layouts and forecast generation, but engineers still decide interconnection coordination, on-site judgments, and tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 158,800 solar energy systems engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 162,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,300 jobs, with approximately 9,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $117,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace this occupation, but it will accelerate design. Generation forecasting and layout optimization speed up routine calculations, shifting engineers from calculating irradiance toward defining systems, managing interconnection, and taking responsibility on site. People who only perform basic calculations will be displaced, while those who understand both integration and the grid will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: System integration: people design the architecture
Grid interconnection coordination: people carry responsibility
On-site judgment: people provide experience
Tradeoff decisions: people determine profit and loss
Operations and maintenance decisions: people set the pace
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a medium AI-exposure category. AI accelerates design, while integration and field work remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Basic calculation is being replaced, not roles accountable for grid interconnection. People who understand both systems and the grid become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in electrical and energy systems and gain field experience early
Advance from design to systems and learn interconnection
Highlight power plant and grid interconnection experience
Select people who understand both systems and the grid

ai_s7_trends: Installed capacity continues to grow
Energy storage integration drives demand
Grid expertise is more valuable

body: Solar Energy Systems Engineers lead photovoltaic system design and integration, coordinating modules, inverters, and grid interconnection implementation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can optimize layouts and forecast generation, but engineers still decide interconnection coordination, on-site judgments, and tradeoffs.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能优化排布与预测发电，但接入协调、现场判断与取舍，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这个岗位，但会提速设计。发电预测与排布优化把常规计算提速，工程师从「算辐照」转向「定系统、管接入、担现场」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础计算的，懂集成也懂电网的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 系统集成：架构靠人
并网协调：责任靠人
现场判断：经验靠人
取舍权衡：盈亏靠人
运维决策：节奏靠人
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个岗位处在中等 AI 曝光区——设计侧被加速，但集成与现场还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「基础计算」动作，不是「并网负责」的岗位。懂系统也懂电网的人反而更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tax software can calculate standard returns automatically, but people still decide what qualifies for deductions, how to plan, and how to communicate with clients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 90,600 tax preparers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 94,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,100 jobs, with approximately 10,400 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $50,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tax preparers, but it will take over data entry. Software automates standard forms, shifting tax preparers from form completion toward policy interpretation, tax-benefit planning, and client support. Pure data entry faces displacement, while professionals who understand tax law and planning become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: People interpret policy.
People develop tax-benefit strategies.
People answer client questions.
People handle complex cases.
People remain accountable for compliance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderately high AI exposure in tax filing. Systems accelerate data entry, but people retain responsibility for judgment and planning.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces completing forms and calculating taxes, not tax planning roles. Tax preparers who understand policy and can develop strategies become scarcer as efficiency improves. The real risk is knowing only how to enter standard returns.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with accounting and finance, and practice tax law and software. Pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so learn planning early.
Advance from completing forms to developing strategies + managing clients, and build policy and client-support expertise.
Highlight credentials and client volume. Firms value stability and accuracy.
Do not evaluate candidates solely for speed. Assess their tax-law foundation. Core professionals who can plan deserve higher incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service filing takes over standard returns.
Demand for tax planning rises.
Professionals who understand policy are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 报税软件能自动算标准单，但哪项能抵、怎么筹、客户怎么聊，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年税务申报员在岗约 9.06 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.47 万人，净增约 0.41 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.04 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.06 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代报税员，但会吃掉录表。标准表单被软件自动化，报税员从「填表」挪向「政策判断、减免筹划、客户答疑」。真正被挤掉的是纯录表，懂税法能筹划的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 政策判断靠人。
减免筹划靠人。
客户答疑靠人。
复杂个案靠人。
合规负责靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的申报区——录表被系统加速，但判断与筹划还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「填表算税」动作，不是「税务筹划」的岗位。懂政策、能做筹划的报税员，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会录标准单的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财会起步多练税法和软件，AI 时代纯录表在缩，早点学筹划。
从「填表」升级成「做筹划 + 管客户」，学政策和答疑。
突出证书和客户量，事务所求稳和准。
选人别只看手快，要看税法功底。能筹划的骨干值得给高提。

ai_s7_trends: 自助申报吃标准单。
筹划需求升。
懂政策更抢手。

body: 报税员采集客户财务信息，依据税法填报税表、计算应缴与抵免，并按时完成申报与答疑。
